key_decisions.rationale: Preserves boat recovery, undergirding, named shoals, fear, gear, and drifting.
key_decisions.before: After hoisting it aboard, the sailors used cables to strengthen the ship. Fearing they would run aground on the Syrtis, they lowered the sea anchor and allowed the ship to be driven.
key_decisions.after: After hoisting it aboard, the sailors used cables to brace the ship. Fearing they would run aground on the Syrtis, they lowered the sea anchor and let the ship be driven along.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and after hoisting it up, they used supports to undergird the ship, and fearing that they might run aground on the Syrtis, they lowered the gear, and so were driven along.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the exact total and human count.
key_decisions.before: Altogether there were two hundred seventy-six people on the ship.
key_decisions.after: There were 276 people in all on the ship.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And we were in all two hundred seventy-six persons in the ship.
